title: Refuse a coordinate value whose text conversion throws as an unknown value
summary: `validateCoordinate` now refuses a coordinate value whose conversion to text throws, such as the JSON object `{"toString":1}`, with `IA-GRAPH-COORDINATE-VALUE-UNKNOWN`, and its message shows that value as `<unprintable>`. It used to throw a `TypeError`, which the runtime door answered with `IA-RUNTIME-REQUEST-INVALID` for such a value in a `traverse` or `context` coordinate or in the `phase` binding. Axis names are now checked by membership in the closed axis list. The admitted axes, the error order, the output and the message for every other value are unchanged.
